market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: Kolkata Knight Riders are a top-tier IPL franchise, having won the title as recently as 2024 and consistently contending for playoffs. In a 10-team T20 league, even the weakest teams rarely have less than a 3–5% chance of winning a future edition. The market-implied 0.7% for KKR is irrationally low and likely reflects temporary order-book imbalances rather than a fair probability. While exact odds two seasons out are uncertain, a conservative 8% estimate still represents a massive edge over the current price.
evidence_points: KKR won the IPL in 2024, showing strong recent form and depth.
T20 cricket has high variance; even bottom teams typically hold a 3–5% chance pre-season.
No news indicates KKR will be absent, relegated, or unable to compete in 2026.
